newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FUTURES FOCUS ON SWISS FRANC, SLACK DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FUTURES FOCUS ON SWISS FRANC, SLACK DOLLAR.

text.p: Recent falls in the dollar put the U.S. currency in focus on Hungary's forex futures markets on Wednesday, dealers said.

September deals in the U.S. unit accounted for a third of the Budapest Commodity Exchange's foreign currency futures turnover while much of the rest was taken up by deals in December Swiss francs, which offer low interest rates with which to speculate against the devaluing forint.
The September dollar fell 45 fillers to 191.95 forints while the December Swiss franc rose 65 fillers to 138.05.

Currency futures trade on the smaller Budapest Stock Exchange was also enlivened by the dollar's fall internationally, seeing 451 million forints worth of trade for the December maturity, which fell 85 fillers to 195.15.
The National Bank of Hungary's midday fix for the dollar was 182.26, down 0.23, while the Swiss franc rose 0.77 to 124.74.
